newsitem.title: USA: Sonic drops amid Q2 earnings warning.
newsitem.headline: Sonic drops amid Q2 earnings warning.

text.p: Shares of Sonic Corp plunged 33 percent after the drive-in restaurant company said its second-quarter earnings would fall short of analysts estimates because of slower-than-expected growth in store openings.
Sonic lost 6-3/4 to 13-5/8 with about 1.4 million shares changing hands, almost five times its normal volume.

"An inability to open units makes people nervous. The company has done better than its peer group as far as sales, but unit growth is what people want to see," said Scott Alaniz, an analyst with Stephens Inc.
Alaniz downgraded Sonic to hold from strong buy. Alex. Brown & Sons also downgraded the stock.
Sonic on Monday said it expected earnings for the second fiscal quarter ended February 28 to fall short of the range of analysts estimates of $0.25 to $0.27 a share.
While the Oklahoma City-based company did not provide a specific forecast, it said it expected the second-quarter results to be about 10 percent higher than the year-ago earnings of $0.21 a share.
Sonic said it expected its earnings growth for fiscal 1997 to be about 10 percent.

Sonic, a drive-in restaurant company, said the expected shortfall reflected slower openings during the quarter. In addition, drive-ins in new markets were taking longer than originally estimated to reach sales and profit goals, it said.
The drive-in restaurant company will open about 36 to 38 company-owned units in fiscal 1997, down from previous estimates of 45 new units, analysts said.
The shortfall in 1997 could also delay the expected opening of 45 company-owned units in 1998, analysts said.
"They're going to have to be a 'show me' company. They have to show investors that they can get units open," Alaniz said.

Sonic said the restaurants as a whole, including franchise and company-owned operations, were performing well, with average unit sales volumes for the second quarter increasing by an estimated eight to nine percent from volumes in the year-ago period.
